title: API Key Authentication
description: Build an Express API that protects routes using API key authentication via a custom middleware.

steps.title: Public endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /public endpoint that returns a welcome message. This route should be accessible without any authentication.
hints: Use app.get('/public', handler) to define the route
Return JSON with a message like { message: 'Welcome to the public endpoint!' }
No auth checks needed for this route

steps.title: Protected endpoint
steps.description: Add a GET /protected endpoint that returns 401 if the x-api-key header is missing or invalid, and returns 200 with data if the API key is valid.
hints: Define a hardcoded valid API key: const API_KEY = 'my-secret-key'
Check req.headers['x-api-key'] against the valid key
Return 401 with { error: 'Unauthorized' } if missing or invalid

steps.title: API key middleware
steps.description: Refactor the API key check into a reusable middleware function that can be applied to any protected route.
hints: Create an apiKeyMiddleware function: (req, res, next) => { ... }
Use app.get('/protected', apiKeyMiddleware, handler) to apply it
Export or reuse the middleware across multiple routes
